import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyExterior
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyTorusRanks
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Free
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Noetherian.Orzech

/-!
# Exterior-power ranks in the torus cup calculation

The exterior power of integral first cohomology and integral cohomology in
the corresponding degree have the same finite free rank. Consequently,
surjectivity of the actual exterior-cup comparison implies its bijectivity
over the integers.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Submodule.module

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The exterior power of integral first cohomology of a finite torus is
finite free of binomial rank. -/
theorem torusCohomologyExteriorPower_free_finite_finrank (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^n
      (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1)) ∧
      Module.Finite ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^n
        (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1)) ∧
        Module.finrank ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^n
          (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1)) =
            d.choose n := by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [exteriorPower.finrank_eq, torusCohomology_finrank, Nat.choose_one_right]

/-- The source of the torus exterior-cup comparison has rank `d.choose n`. -/
theorem torusCohomologyExteriorPower_finrank (d n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^n
      (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1)) = d.choose n :=
  (torusCohomologyExteriorPower_free_finite_finrank d n).2.2

/-- Surjectivity of the actual torus exterior-cup comparison implies
bijectivity because both its source and target are finite free of equal rank. -/
theorem torusCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective_of_surjective (d n : ℕ)
    (h : Function.Surjective
      (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n)) :
    Function.Bijective
      (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) := by
  let e : (⋀[ℤ]^n (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) 1)) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n :=
    LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ (by
      rw [torusCohomologyExteriorPower_finrank, torusCohomology_finrank])
  exact ⟨IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective e.toLinearMap
    (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of (Fin d → Circle)) n) e.injective h, h⟩

end Mumford.Analytic
